question: Asked in an SDE intern technical interview: differentiate between breadth-first search (BFS) and depth-first search (DFS).
lookingFor: Correct explanation of traversal order and the data structure each uses
Complexity analysis for both time and space
Knowing which problems suit each algorithm
Ability to write the core code quickly
followUps: Why does BFS find the shortest path in an unweighted graph?
How would you detect a cycle in a directed graph using DFS?
How would you implement DFS iteratively?
Which uses more memory on a very wide tree and which on a very deep one?
